price_basis: Yahoo OKE, split-adjusted to today's shares: its 2:1 of 2001-06-12 precedes the P/E window (2002-01-01 on) and every per-share fact; its 2:1 of 2012-06-04 is the 'splits' record (before it the builder multiplies Yahoo's close by 2, after it the per-share facts published before it are halved, on_basis); its 11422:10000 factor of 2014-02-03 (the ONE Gas separation) is the 'distributions' record: before it the builder multiplies Yahoo's close by it, and from it the factor is undone for the days before it, so every price is the close as traded

splits.note: 'On June 1, 2012, we completed our previously announced two-for-one split of our common stock. The two-for-one split was accomplished by a distribution on June 1, 2012, of one share of ONEOK common stock for each share outstanding and held by holders of record on May 24, 2012. ONEOK shares began trading on a post-split basis on the New York Stock Exchange beginning at the opening of trading on June 4, 2012.' (OK52); Yahoo's split date is 2012-06-04, the first trading day on the new basis. Per-share figures published before 2012-06-04 are halved and share counts doubled (on_basis); the Q2 2012 release and later filings report on the new basis ('split-adjusted')

distributions.note: the separation of ONE Gas, Inc. (NYSE: OGS): 'On January 31, 2014, ONEOK completed the Distribution and the separation of ONE Gas from ONEOK. ONE Gas is now an independent, publicly traded, 100 percent regulated natural gas distribution utility trading under the ticker symbol “OGS” on the New York Stock Exchange. Following the close of business on January 31, ONEOK distributed one share of ONE Gas Common Stock, par value $0.01 per share, for every four shares of common stock of ONEOK held by shareholders of record as of the close of business on January 21, 2014, the record date for the Distribution.' (8-K accepted 2014-02-05 after the close, OK68; the ratio and the record date were stated in the 8-K of 2014-01-10, OK66: 'ONEOK will distribute one share of common stock of ONE Gas, par value $0.01 per share, for every four shares of ONEOK common stock held by ONEOK shareholders of record as of the close of business on January 21, 2014, the record date for the Distribution.'); Yahoo books it as an 11422:10000 split on 2014-02-03, the first day the stock traded without ONE Gas; it is not a split, so from that date its factor is undone for the days before it and prices stay as traded (the window's days before it with ONE Gas, the SO Mirant reading); per-share facts are not restated, and the history keeps the distribution business until a filing restates it (the FY2014 10-K)
